facts.fact: Airtel Nigeria launched its 200-rack Airtel Data Centre in Lekki, Lagos, offering colocation and cloud services commercially, with full operations beginning immediately; the launch date is not stated, so the article date 2022-04-14 is used.

Airtel Nigeria's Lekki, Lagos data centre, in service at launch, was awarded Tier III ANSI/TIA-942 certification by EPI per the operator; the certification date is not stated, so the article date 2022-04-14 is used.
